gripOrHq.title: Rigged Investments
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Rigged Investments when it is installed. At the start of each of your turns, take [1] from Rigged Investments. When all the bits have been removed, trash Rigged Investments.

gripOrHq.title: Rigged Investments
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Rigged Investments when it is installed. At the start of each of your turns, take [1] from Rigged Investments. When all the bits have been removed, trash Rigged Investments.

gripOrHq.title: Short-Term Contract
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Short-Term Contract when it is installed. When all the bits have been removed, trash Short-Term Contract. A: Take [2] from Short-Term Contract.

gripOrHq.title: Top Runners' Conference
gripOrHq.rulesText: Gain [2] at the start of each of your turns. Trash Top Runners' Conference when you make a run.

heapOrArchives.title: All-Nighter
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run; whether or not that run is successful, you may then make another run.

heapOrArchives.title: R&D Interface
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

heapOrArchives.title: Deep Thought
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Whenever you make a successful run on R&D, give the Corp a Thought counter. Three or more Thought counters allow you to look at the top card of R&D at the start of each of your turns. The Corp may remove all Virus counters by forgoing its next three actions.

heapOrArchives.title: Junkyard BBS
heapOrArchives.rulesText: A, [1]: Bring the top card from your trash into your hand.

scoreArea.title: Corporate Downsizing
scoreArea.rulesText: When you score Corporate Downsizing, show to Runner any number of agenda cards stored in HQ. Gain bits equal to twice the combined agenda points of these cards; then shuffle them into R&D.

scoreArea.title: Corporate Downsizing
scoreArea.rulesText: When you score Corporate Downsizing, show to Runner any number of agenda cards stored in HQ. Gain bits equal to twice the combined agenda points of these cards; then shuffle them into R&D.

rig.title: Zetatech Software Installer
rig.rulesText: Put [2] bits on Software Installer when it is installed. Use these bits only to pay for installing programs. You may use these bits to install a program overwriting Software Installer itself. If you use any of these bits, replace them at the start of your next turn.

rig.title: R&D Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

rig.title: Crash Everett, Inventive Fixer
rig.rulesText: Whenever you draw one or more cards from your stack, draw an extra card; then choose one of the cards drawn and either trash it or return it to the top of your stack. Only one unique card of a particular name can be in play at a time. If for some reason more than one is in play, trash all but one.

rig.title: Short-Term Contract
rig.rulesText: Put [12] from the bank on Short-Term Contract when it is installed. When all the bits have been removed, trash Short-Term Contract. A: Take [2] from Short-Term Contract.

ice.title: Misleading Access Menus
ice.rulesText: *End the run unless Runner pays [1]. Gain [3] when you rez Misleading Access Menus.

root.title: Olivia Salazar
root.rulesText: For half cost, rounded down, rez a piece of ice installed on this fort. Derez that ice at the end of the run. Use this ability only once during each run on this fort.

ice.title: Snowbank
ice.rulesText: *End the run unless Runner pays [1]. Gain [3] when you rez Snowbank.

ice.title: Minotaur
ice.rulesText: For each rezzed code gate or wall installed outside Minotaur, Minotaur has one "*End the run" subroutine.

ice.title: Misleading Access Menus
ice.rulesText: *End the run unless Runner pays [1]. Gain [3] when you rez Misleading Access Menus.

root.title: Red Herrings
root.rulesText: Runner must pay [5], in addition to any other costs, to steal agendas accessed from this fort, even on the run during which Runner trashes Red Herrings.

root.title: Tesseract Fort Construction
root.rulesText: All ice on this fort has an additional subroutine, "*End the run unless Runner pays [1]," after all other subroutines.

encounteredIce.title: Minotaur
encounteredIce.rulesText: For each rezzed code gate or wall installed outside Minotaur, Minotaur has one "*End the run" subroutine.
